# Observability Standards

Patterns for metrics, logging, tracing, and dashboards that span multiple
projects (exporters, plugins, services that publish `/metrics`).

## Contents

- [metric-naming.md](metric-naming.md) — Prometheus metric naming
  pattern: `<prefix>_[<subsystem>_]<name>_<unit_or_role>` with unit
  suffixes, cardinality-via-labels rule, and migration guidance for
  existing non-conforming metrics.
